about: The share cards' scenes (docs/plan.md slice 51, "The share cards"; Rapha, 2026-10-22: the illustrated backgrounds): one hand-painted page a place template and one for the streak, each 1024 x 1536 WebP whose lower third fades into bare parchment, under the card's words. The apps bundle this folder as it is (the iPhone as a folder reference, Android as assets, the desktop app as a bundle resource). `places` maps a place's template (contract/places.json; Home is `home`) to its scene, `streak` names the streak card's and `fallback` the scene of a place without a template. Each scene's `stand` is where the standard-bearer's feet stand, as shares of the scene's width and height, and `height` the figure's height (its box in contract/figures/figures.json `extras.streak_banner`, banner tip to feet) as a share of the scene's height. The pages were drafted with an image model for Pluxia and are hand-finished before the release (docs/tasks.md); every file has its row in contract/design/ledger.json.
